import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/hgnc_id/HGNC:3274"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
    hgnc = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    docs = hgnc['response']['docs'][0]
    print("HGNC symbol:", docs.get("symbol"))
    print("HGNC name:", docs.get("name"))
    print("HGNC alias_symbol:", docs.get("alias_symbol"))
    print("HGNC prev_symbol:", docs.get("prev_symbol"))
    print("uniprot_ids:", docs.get("uniprot_ids"))
